generator.tagline: One source image in, a complete app-icon set out.
generator.exportEmpty: Select at least one platform to export.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutText: Icon Stack generates production-ready app icons for the web, macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. Everything runs in your browser – no image ever leaves your device.

background.transparentHint: Export with no plate behind the artwork.

preview.title: Preview
preview.none: No raster sizes for this platform.
preview.maskApplied: {{platform}} rounds the icon when it displays it. The exported file stays square.

source.mainSubtitle: PNG or SVG, 1024x1024 square works best.
source.alternateSubtitle: For dark, monochrome and taskbar variants.
source.alternateHint: An alternate image lets dark, monochrome and taskbar variants use different artwork – a mark that reads on a light plate often does not read knocked out on a dark one.

notes.favicon: Browsers scale this to 16px – keep the mark simple.
notes.pwa: Maskable variants add safe-area padding for Android.
notes.windowsStore: Store tiles stay transparent; the plate color lives in the MSIX manifest.
notes.trayIcon: Menu-bar icons are template images on macOS.

platform.appleIconHint: The .icon format layers light, dark and monochrome renders with system-applied glass and shadow.
platform.glassHint: Adds the specular highlight Apple applies to layered icons.
platform.translucencyHint: Lets the layer beneath show through.
platform.monochromeHint: Android 13+ themed icons use a single-color silhouette.
platform.includeSvgHint: Modern browsers prefer it; it scales without a raster step.
platform.faviconSourceHint: Favicons render at 16px in a browser tab. A simplified drawing survives that; a detailed one turns to mud.
platform.traySourceHint: Menu-bar and tray icons render at 16-22px, often monochrome. A simplified silhouette reads where full artwork does not.
platform.svgDarkModeHint: Embeds a prefers-color-scheme rule so the SVG favicon inverts in dark browser chrome.

replace.title: Replace the source image?
replace.body: Every per-platform setting is tuned against the current image. Replacing it with {{fileName}} keeps your platform selection and resets nothing else, but the previews all re-render.
